title: Mass limits of currents with summable increments (parent I.5, printed (19))
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ and A_ν, B_ν ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) (ν ∈ ℕ) with A_{ν+1}(ω) = A_ν(ω) + B_ν(ω) for all ν and all test forms ω, and Σ_ν M(B_ν) < ∞. Then there is A′ ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) such that A_ν ⇀ A′ (weakly), M(A′) ≤ M(A_0) + Σ_ν M(B_ν), every current D_ν with D_ν(ω) = A′(ω) − A_ν(ω) for all ω satisfies M(D_ν) ≤ Σ_μ M(B_{μ+ν}), and spt A′ ⊆ F for every closed F containing all spt A_ν.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (A B : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k), (∀ ν ω, A (ν + 1) ω = A ν ω + B ν ω) → (∑' ν, (B ν).mass) < ∞ → ∃ A' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, WeaklyConvergesOn A A' ∧ A'.mass ≤ (A 0).mass + ∑' ν, (B ν).mass ∧ (∀ (ν : ℕ) (Dν : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k), (∀ ω, Dν ω = A' ω - A ν ω) → Dν.mass ≤ ∑' μ, (B (μ + ν)).mass) ∧ ∀ F : Set (Eucl N), IsClosed F → (∀ ν, (A ν).support ⊆ F) → A'.support ⊆ F
